name: Shell monoethylene glycol plant, Jurong Island, Singapore (OMEGA process)
description: MEG via the OMEGA route (EO to ethylene carbonate, then catalytic hydrolysis) - the first fully catalytic EG process; supported by Shell's 2015 ethylene-unit upgrade on the island

sources.note: Chemanager, 9 Apr 2015 (ethylene upgrade supporting the Jurong Island MEG plant); OMEGA described as the first fully catalytic EG process (process literature); plant capacity not stated in open pages; read 2026-10-28
